messages.author: Ticklepuss
messages.text: Nobody is worried since the penalties are soft.  It's likely the league will get close to 99% complete - it always seems to work out, but it's mostly due to 90% of the league being very accommodating to the douchers that show up the last week.... Hard to say the league will get to 100% with a new(er) guy leading the the pukefest with 12 gp...Even if we inevitably get to 100% of games played the last 30 minutes of the season, I do think leadership should look into some sort of midseason marker....it's cute and all, and people are busy, yada yada....if you can't carve out 20 minutes a week, or an hour over a weekend, just hang out until the diaper league rears it's ugly head

messages.text: the penalties are worthless so i could care less if i finish.  i also think i traded my 1st, so care even less actually

messages.text:
Also who came up with this rule?

*If the GM who does not finish, has traded their draft pick for the year they do not finish, that pick can be no higher than 5th overall (so as not to impact SB GMs), and will be placed in the lottery, with their points % (subject to b) ) determining their draft lottery odds .*
